==Overview== 
[[File:Elemental Type Chart.png|100px|thumb|left|Elemental type chart.]] The Fire type is one of the five elemental types found in Clash of Critters.

[[Critters]] and [[Zobos]] of the Fire type are weak to [[Water]].

They are also super effective against [[Grass]].
